placeholders.description: Active session slug; appears in close report header for operator attribution.
Canonical session identifier (sid) used as the manifest key and external audit filename stem.
Terminal state of the session at close-invocation time. close MUST only run from DONE/FAILED/ABORTED; the transition target SEALED is also enumerated for symmetry with state_transition.to.
Decision Velocity Tier per Addendum v1.0.1. COLD tier requires emission of an external audit artifact (Addendum §D); HOT/WARM may omit it.
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when close was invoked (close.invoked event ts).
ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when close.completed was emitted (after manifest generation succeeded).
Integer count of artifacts whose sha256 hashes were captured in final_manifest.artifact_hashes. Rendered as JSON-encoded number (Article XVI typed substitution).
Evidence reference to the .state/final_manifest.json artifact produced by this close invocation.
sha256 of the audit-chain head event at close-completion time. Article X — audit replay must be possible from this anchor.
Evidence reference to the COLD-tier external audit emission at audit/external/<UTC-date>/<sid>.audit.json. Required iff plan.tier == COLD per Addendum v1.0.1 §D; omitted otherwise.
Short human-readable summary of the session outcome carried forward from retro (consumed, never edited). Escaped as data, never instruction.
